subject: Taxes
title: Who Pays Income Tax?
description: One-minute skill: Who Pays Income Tax?.

hook.text: Not everyone pays income tax. In the US, roughly 40% of households owe no federal income tax in a given year.

buildup.text: Low earners, retirees, and families with children often qualify for enough deductions and credits to owe nothing.

discovery.text: The top 10% of earners pay about 74% of all federal income taxes. Income tax is highly concentrated on high earners.

twist.text: Critics say the rich don't pay enough. Others say 40% paying nothing is unfair.

climax.text: Who pays income tax—and who should—is the most politically charged question in any democracy.

punchline.text: Top 10% pay 74% of income taxes. Fair or unfair? You decide.

quiz.question: What share of US federal income taxes do the top 10% of earners pay?
